purpose: Separate represented rescue viability, restore execution, external-world reconciliation, and post-restore authority before consequential resume.

RecoveryAdapterRecord.conditional: post_restore is required when restore.status=SUCCESS. Evidence refs are required for represented VERIFIED/PASSED/SUCCESS/INDEPENDENT positive-or-negative observations where specified.

decision_rules.property: checkpoint existence does not prove rescue viability
decision_rules.decision: reachability and required independence/drill state must be resolved separately
when independent_rescue_required=true, SHARED_FATE -> REPAIR_RECOVERY_PATH and UNKNOWN -> RESOLVE_RECOVERY_UNCERTAINTY; when false, no separate rescue plane is manufactured merely for ceremony

decision_rules.property: restore drill obligation is explicit and bounded
decision_rules.decision: when restore_drill.required=true, FAILED -> REPAIR_RECOVERY_PATH and NOT_TESTED/UNKNOWN -> RESOLVE_RECOVERY_UNCERTAINTY

decision_rules.property: successful restore is not safe resume
decision_rules.decision: restore SUCCESS requires post_restore world and authority summaries before resume

decision_rules.property: world reconciliation remains distinct from state restore
authority is re-evaluated after restore where required

decision_rules.decision: restore SUCCESS + world NOT_REQUIRED/CLEARED + authority NOT_REQUIRED/AUTHORIZED -> RESUME

verification_boundary: represented recovery-path, drill, restore, and post-restore composition only; no external rescue reachability, evidence authenticity, world settlement, authority truth, or consequence-classification claim
